scope: Actual-owner rear preflight for the queue dependency leaf
finding: The protocol previously checked role, crew, stationary topology and native reverse input, but a leaf blocked by geometry/actors/support could still consent and receive a hold commit. Parents may be intentionally blocked by that leaf, so preflighting every member would prevent the intended dependency chain.
implementation: Extract existing ordinary long8m/stop6m and spatial-only short3.5m/stop2m fallback into DrivingRearPlan, preserving reasons and bounds. Actual leaf owner consumes it in VERIFY and COMMIT, then rechecks original expiry and canonical context. No target or clearance is retained; failed VERIFY refuses consent, failed COMMIT requests original-token release. Ordinary native issue consumes the same helper and retains its existing atomic pose/crew/order/journal checks.
cost: At most two existing bounded rear observations per leaf VERIFY/COMMIT. Each observation retains its original two actor queries,64-actor evaluation ceiling and70-ray maximum. No new recurring scan, timer or worker. Actual overhead unmeasured.
limits: Observation only; no native queue leg or crossing implemented. COMMIT refusal can arrive after another owner briefly applies its hold. Original broker release/expiry bounds that state. Execution must resample. Audits paused.

validation.fullPipeline: 1476 existing tests and full sequential compiler/FSM/config/docs/parity/performance/package gates passed.
